_meta.description: Heart event #2 for npc_janis: The Raid Aftermath

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [After a raid. Janis watches the militia regroup]

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Your machines made the difference. I've seen Council garrisons do less.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: That's... not something I say lightly.

options.text: The machines are only as good as the people using them.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I've been to twelve Beacon Towns. None of them have this.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: This... cohesion. This willingness to fight for each other.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: My report to the Council will reflect that. Accurately.
